capability: Complete a release when all actions and runtime telemetry remain healthy.
successCriteria: Jason reaches decision(release_complete) and no rollback decision is present.

capability: Stop the release at the build gate before any deployment action.
successCriteria: Jason perceives build failure and stops before staging or production deploy.

capability: Stop the release at the test gate after a successful build.
successCriteria: Jason perceives test failure and does not continue validation or deployment.

capability: Stop the release at the security gate before staging deployment.
successCriteria: Jason blocks deployment when the security scan fails.

capability: Use staging as a production gate and stop release when staging verification fails.
successCriteria: Jason detects unstable staging and prevents production deployment.

capability: React to business-endpoint failures that pass /health by rolling back from telemetry.
successCriteria: Jason rolls back only after telemetry creates production instability.

capability: Recover when production deployment fails after earlier gates passed.
successCriteria: Jason perceives production deploy failure, attempts rollback, and records rollback_production.

capability: Recover when production deploy succeeds but production health verification fails.
successCriteria: Jason perceives failed production health, runs rollback, and records rollback_production.

capability: Rollback after a transient production health failure, verify recovered production, then continue deploying the same candidate.
successCriteria: Jason handles the first production health failure, rolls back, observes stable production, retries candidate deployment, and completes the release.

capability: Treat latency-only instability as ambiguous and pause for reobservation before recovery.
successCriteria: Jason chooses pause_reobserve for latency-only instability before deciding rollback.

capability: Distinguish telemetry collection failure from application failure and request manual intervention.
successCriteria: Jason pauses and escalates instead of blindly rolling back when telemetry is unavailable.

capability: Pause and reobserve a transient latency spike, then keep the release after telemetry recovers.
successCriteria: Jason records reobserve_recovered and avoids rollback after telemetry becomes stable.

capability: Escalate to manual intervention when production recovery action fails.
successCriteria: Jason attempts rollback, perceives rollback failure, and escalates.
